thesis: Microsoft's reported quarterly revenue rose 16.0% year over year, diluted EPS rose 10.4%, and net income rose 10.7%. Growth in both sales and earnings supports retaining the existing 24 simulated shares. The November 7 close provides recent price context, and the supplied evidence gives little basis for increasing the position.
uncertainty: The book has no as-of market valuation. The supplied November 7 close was reconstructed from a rounded historical observation. One reported quarter leaves the durability of earnings growth uncertain, and the supplied hashes establish consistency only.
allocation_reasoning: The existing cost basis is 9753.40, or 9.75% of the 100000 cost-basis denominator, within the 25% limit. Holding incurs no fill fee and keeps cash at 90246.60, above the 20000 minimum.

exit_conditions.text: Reassess the position for reduction or exit if fresh, comparable quarterly evidence shows year-over-year declines in both diluted EPS and net income, or if a correction materially weakens the reported growth.
